en: Um, would it be all right if I asked one{SAUT}more thing?
Can you change anyone's heart, no{SAUT}matter who they are?
If they're evil...{OPTION}If they're on the navigator.
Yeah. If there's evil in someone's heart,{SAUT}we should be able to find them on the{SAUT}Metaverse Navigator.{PAGE}Why do you ask?
No, the Metaverse Navigator. It usually{SAUT}only reacts to criminals.{PAGE}Why do you ask?
Oh, no reason. I was just a little curious.{PAGE}Well, we've finished up here, so let's{SAUT}head back!
